> Blog · Summit Az · 2026-09-09

# Summary
SEO-ready draft "Your Post-Monsoon Plumbing Checklist for Mesa and East Valley Homes", prepared Sep 9, 2026. Status in the file: DRAFT awaiting Kim's approval. No publish record for it was found in the SEO change log or the Oct 1 handoff blog list, so treat it as unpublished.

# Rank Math settings (proposed)
- Focus keyword: "plumbing checklist Mesa AZ". Secondaries: post monsoon plumbing inspection, fall plumbing maintenance Mesa, water heater flush Mesa AZ, East Valley plumber.
- Title: "Plumbing Checklist for Mesa AZ Homes After Monsoon Season" (57). Meta 145 characters.
- Slug: `post-monsoon-plumbing-checklist-mesa` (evergreen; "september" dropped so the post can be refreshed each year).

# Content
- A 7-point checklist: clear storm debris from outdoor drains, slab leak warning signs, flush the water heater, test water pressure, service the softener, exercise shutoff valves, run unused fixtures.
- Links to the Mesa drain cleaning page and related posts.

# Decisions and status
- Note for reuse: the focus keyword was chosen before the Sep 15 rule set (keyword research with volume 100+). Re-check volume and the current monsoon cluster before publishing.
